title: LP2-15 number-row spacing: a source-bound line-gap audit
question: Is the reported extra vertical gap before the fourth LP2-15 number row measurable on the original JPEG, and how does it compare with neighboring text rows?
summary: The four number rows leave 62, 61 and 79 blank-pixel gaps. The last is at least 17 pixels wider than the earlier panel gaps; selected neighboring rune-text gaps are 73–75 pixels. No word-gap bitstream or font cause is established.

scope.representation: Fixed source-image rectangles on the three hashed 2400×3600 JPEGs; vertical ink-row bands and blank interline rows, not text transcription.
scope.procedure: Threshold grayscale pixels, group ink rows into printed lines, list every line box and intervening blank-row count; independently rederive at the main threshold and repeat at two alternative thresholds.
scope.parameters: Rectangles, cutoff 160, five ink pixels per row, maximum 14 blank rows within a printed line, threshold sensitivity 100 and 200; all fixed in plan.json.
scope.exclusions: The absent forum screenshots and specific word-gap examples, bit interpretation, fallback-font mechanism, and any claim about LP2 plaintext.

finding: At threshold 160 the LP2-15 number-row gaps are 62, 61, 79 pixels. The final anomaly persists with the same 17-pixel separation at thresholds 100 and 200. Lower LP2-15 rune text has six 74-pixel gaps; selected LP2-14/16 text gaps are 73–75 pixels.
limitations: This verifies one reported line-gap observation, not the word-gap hypothesis or a binary channel. The numeric panel and runic controls use different content and layout, so their difference cannot identify typesetting cause. The source screenshots are not preserved in the supplied transcript.
next_steps: Recover the original word-gap screenshots or identify exact page/row/glyph coordinates; independently annotate a frozen sample and compare font/kerning controls before defining a binary classification and decoder.

review.reviewer: Codex; independent byte-row projection check; human review pending

reproduction.environment: Python 3.12 and Pillow; independent check.py and plot.py --check

visuals.caption: Three LP2-15 number-panel interline gaps and descriptive controls on adjacent rune-text pages.
